doctrine: Fonz creative core + ads default: hit all neurons, front-load impact, start with hook. Scene a IS the hook. One good-weird quirk per board, relational, encoding the story. Art theory (color, composition, typography) intact through every iteration. Winner engines from the shoot-20260824 panels.

orchard.know_do: fresh-roast delivery exists; order a bag
orchard.quirk: the roast steam does not drift, it LEANS toward the sleepy man like a beckoning finger, and he leans back into it; the deviation encodes the pull

scenes.a: Dawn on a suburban porch. A man in a bathrobe flings open his front-yard mailbox and thick, fragrant coffee-roast steam rolls out of it like a chimney. He leans face-first into the cloud, eyes closed, grinning, and the steam visibly leans back toward him.
scenes.b: A warm kitchen in golden side-light. The man tips a plain paper bag and glossy coffee beans avalanche into a hand grinder, a few bouncing on the counter. The thin steam from a kettle behind him bends gently toward him instead of rising straight.
scenes.c: Extreme close-up of a pour-over brewing: the coffee bloom swells and breathes like a tiny sunrise. Pull back to the man cradling the mug in both hands at a window, shoulders dropping as he exhales.

orchard.narration: The mailbox opens and Tuesday's roast climbs out like weather. Beans this fresh don't pour, they applaud. One slow cup, and the morning belongs to you.
orchard.closer: Orchard Hill Coffee, roasted the week it lands. The pipeline behind this spot is public, link under the video.
orchard.bed: Warm acoustic morning folk instrumental, brushed drums, gentle optimistic fingerpicked guitar, sunrise feeling, no vocals

lantern.audience: parents awake at three a.m. hearing a noise
lantern.know_do: one screen says the house is fine; go back to sleep
lantern.quirk: as the phone declares the house safe, the hallway nightlights dim one by one behind her, the house itself exhaling goodnight

scenes.a: Night interior, handheld feel. A barefoot woman in pajamas sprints down a dark staircase, her phone flashlight swinging wild shadows across family photos on the wall, real urgency in her stride.
scenes.b: She stops dead in a dark hallway, breathing hard. The phone in her raised hand lights her face from below. ON THE PHONE'S OWN DISPLAY, filling its screen, a large clear banner reads SYSTEM STABLE, the text flat on the glass of the phone and nowhere else.
scenes.c: Wide, calm hallway shot from behind: she walks back up the stairs unhurried, and the small warm nightlights along the corridor dim one after another behind her like a wave, the house settling dark and safe.

lantern.narration: Three a.m., a thump, and your feet decide before you do. One glance, and the house says it first: all is well. The lights tuck themselves in behind you.
lantern.closer: Lantern Street, the page that opens the right screen. The pipeline behind this spot is public, link under the video.
lantern.bed: Soft ambient nocturne instrumental, felt piano over deep warm pads, slow heartbeat pulse, deeply reassuring, no vocals

harbor.audience: first-time buyers scared of the process
harbor.know_do: one agent, one street; book a walkthrough
harbor.draw: being welcomed; the open gate is the velvet rope with a gap in it
harbor.quirk: the SOLD sticker lands slightly tilted and she leaves it crooked; joy slapped it on, nobody measures joy

scenes.a: Bright suburban morning. A warm, confident real-estate agent stands on a porch giving a big genuine two-arm wave; a young couple on the sidewalk waves back laughing; the white picket-fence gate between them stands wide open.
scenes.b: Close on a lawn sign: her hand slaps a red SOLD sticker across the front of the For Sale yard sign and it lands slightly tilted; she pats it once and leaves it crooked; the couple behind her laughs. The only readable text is the words on the yard sign and sticker.
scenes.c: Golden hour. The couple stands in their new open doorway holding up keys that catch the light; behind them a warmly staged living room glows rich with lamps, books and plants.

harbor.narration: The gate is already open, that's the whole trick. The sticker lands crooked because joy doesn't measure. One street, one agent, and a door that knows your name.
harbor.closer: Harbor Lane Realty, one agent, one street. The pipeline behind this spot is public, link under the video.
harbor.bed: Neighborly warm folk instrumental, easy strummed acoustic guitar with light handclaps and soft strings, front-porch welcome feeling, no vocals

slowroad.audience: burned-out workers doom-scrolling trips they never book
slowroad.know_do: small slow group trips; book one
slowroad.quirk: her paper luggage tag flutters hard like a small bird trying to take off whenever the world speeds past, and only rests when she arrives; the tag wants to hurry, she does not

scenes.a: A woman steps onto the open door step of a slowly moving vintage train, one hand on the rail, leaning out into the light, hair and a paper luggage tag on her suitcase streaming in the wind, a wide grin over her shoulder.
scenes.b: A narrow market alley alive with motion: vendors, steam, bolts of fabric unrolling. She walks at half the crowd's speed through the middle, her luggage tag fluttering hard, while everyone around her passes in slight motion blur.
scenes.c: Dusk at a clifftop bus stop above the sea. She sits on her suitcase watching the water, unhurried. The paper luggage tag beside her finally hangs perfectly still.

slowroad.narration: The train barely moves, and that's the invitation. Walk at half speed and the market doubles. When the tag stops fluttering, you've arrived.
slowroad.closer: Slow Road Travel, go slower, see more. The pipeline behind this spot is public, link under the video.
slowroad.bed: Unhurried wandering travel instrumental, hand percussion, warm acoustic guitar, distant accordion color, dusty golden light feeling, no vocals

guard: Natural skin texture with visible pores and slight imperfections, documentary realism, no beauty smoothing, imperfect practical lighting, real micro-expressions, natural motion timing with small human hesitations. No readable on-screen text anywhere in frame, no logos, no brand marks. Keep hands either fully out of frame or large, simple and clearly articulated. NO narration, NO voiceover, NO captions, NO avatar or presenter, no music, natural ambient sound only. One single continuous live-action scene, about 5 seconds, subject centered, raw b-roll for an edit.
text_exception_clause: Exception to the text rule: the one piece of readable on-screen text is exactly the one named in the scene description, rendered exactly where the scene places it, and nothing else.
